summary: Full regression of the new Public Bounty Board surface (anonymous read, nation filtering, NPC perpetrator visibility, character petty/minor hiding), NPC hunting payout (claim_npc_bounty), and a smoke pass on all previously-shipped law / companions / image / chronicle endpoints. New pytest file `test_bounty_board.py` (13/13 PASS) plus re-run of existing `test_law_system.py` (17/17 PASS) = 30/30 backend. Frontend /bounties verified anonymously and while authenticated, nation filter pills re-fetch correctly with proper cross-nation isolation, nav-bounties link routes to /bounties.

issues: BountyCard for worst_severity='major' uses bg-red-900/15 + text-red-100 — at 15% bg opacity the card body and labels (perpetrator name, '1 open crime', and even the amount) are visibly washed out on the dark gradient. The capital/regicide tints (rose-900/20, fuchsia-900/30) read fine. Suggest bumping the major tint to bg-red-900/25 or strengthening text to text-red-50 for readability parity. See SEVERITY_TINT in /app/frontend/src/pages/BountyBoard.js line 11–17.

Non-selected nation pills use text-gray-400 on bg-black/30 with a border-gray-600/30 — labels like 'Dhor Khuldor' and 'Veiled Realms' are low-contrast and difficult to scan; consider text-gray-300 minimum.

action_items: Bump 'major' severity tint contrast on the bounty board cards (BountyBoard.js SEVERITY_TINT).
Raise non-selected filter pill text color from gray-400 to gray-300 for readability.
critical_code_review_comments: law_service.py get_bounty_board() hides character bounties with worst_severity in ('petty','minor') by relying on the documented visibility list ['major','capital','regicide']. This is correct per the spec, but it depends entirely on the worst_severity field being kept in sync by _refresh_bounty. If a future refactor adds a new severity tier (e.g., 'misdemeanor'), the visibility filter and the propagation in _refresh_bounty 'order' constant would need to be updated together — they live in separate places (lines 267 and 341). Consider centralising the SEVERITY_TIERS / public_severities definitions.

server.py /api/bounty-board has no rate limit and no Cache-Control headers; since it is fully public it would be a cheap DoS target. Recommend adding a short-TTL cache (e.g., Cache-Control: public, max-age=15) and per-IP rate limit.

claim_npc_bounty() is idempotent by virtue of 'status=open' filter, but the return type does not distinguish 'first claim' vs 'already claimed' (total_payout==0 in both 'never had crimes' and 'already claimed' cases). Consider returning crimes_closed==0 + an explicit already_claimed flag so the AI/UI can distinguish 'this NPC was never wanted' from 'someone else claimed first'.
server.py is now 4710 lines — modularisation overdue (law, image, admin, bounty routers each in their own file).
BountyBoard.js fetches with api.get('/bounty-board') — confirm this client strips/keeps the right base url; current behaviour works because api util prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+'/api'. Good.
